extension.summary: Bias lighting from Kodi to WLED
extension.description: AmbientWLED samples the TV picture on CoreELEC and drives a GLEDOPTO GL-C-017WL-D (or any WLED) over DDP. It does not touch HDMI, eARC, or audio. Enable it from the setup wizard.
extension.news: Calibrate sync: a white bar walks the screen edge so the sync delay can be matched to the strip.
